notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head and beard artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
Hair cap, face and ears remain rigidly attached to the head.
The full moustache and beard mass is a subtle spring layer.
Armor, shoulder plate, blue scarf, sword and all body equipment remain in the static body layer.
A narrow hidden neck/scarf region behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head translation and rotation.
A small hidden skin strip beneath the beard was reconstructed only where beard motion could reveal it.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay containing only the eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left, hair_right and ponytail were skipped because they do not add useful independent motion for this portrait.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
